retained_failures: The first implementation omitted linear mipmaps; corrected before the passing runs.
Decal sampling leaked at edges where bounds analysis selected clamp; ported native quad containment and backing/subset selection. Both platforms initially failed draw 19075 before this correction.
limitations: Only scale/translate CTMs and blur/matrix chains with a real blur are newly handled.
Drop-shadow restores, all-identity lists, near-integer transforms, rotations and source clipping still require further work.
Translation magnitude above 2^20 is declined by the resampling route.
Counts include no-ops and explicit declines. Candidate raster driver does not link Skia; only the reference does.
This is not a complete Skia-free browser compile, link or run.
